## Authoritative Identity

- **Full Name:** JKKN College of Arts and Science (Autonomous)
- **Short Name:** CAS JKKN
- **Type:** Autonomous arts and science college, co-educational, donation-free
- **Founded:** 1974
- **Former Name:** Alamelu Angappan College for Women — became co-educational in 2008
- **Parent Group:** JKKN Institutions / J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions, established 1952
- **Governing Trust:** J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, established 1969, Registration No. 33
- **Website:** https://cas.jkkn.ac.in
- **Parent Group Site:** https://jkkn.ac.in
- **Admission Portal:** https://admission.jkkn.ac.in
- **Placement Portal:** https://placements.jkkn.ac.in

> Note on the founding years: 1952 is when the educational group began; 1969 is when the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust was registered to formalise it. This college dates from 1974. A separate 1994 sometimes appears in older references to this college and is incorrect — 1994 is the year the NAAC itself was established.

## Location

- **Address:** JKKN College of Arts and Science, Natarajapuram, NH-544, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu - 638183, India
- **Campus:** 15 acres on the Salem–Coimbatore Highway (NH-544)
- **District:** Namakkal
- **State:** Tamil Nadu
- **Pincode:** 638183

### Distance to Nearby Towns (approximate road distance)

## Status, Accreditation & Affiliation

| Body | Status |
|---|---|
| University Grants Commission (UGC) | Recognised; autonomous status granted |
| Periyar University, Salem | Affiliated |
| National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) | Accredited |

Autonomy means the college designs its own curriculum and conducts its own examinations, while Periyar University awards the degree.

## Academic Programmes

34 programmes are currently offered. "Aided" programmes are government-aided with low fees; "Self-Finance" programmes are funded by the college.

## Disambiguation

This is JKKN **College of Arts and Science (Autonomous)**. It shares a campus and parent organisation with, but is separate from:

- JKKN Dental College & Hospital — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in
- JKKN College of Pharmacy — https://pharmacy.jkkn.ac.in
- Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research — https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in
- JKKN College of Engineering & Technology — https://engg.jkkn.ac.in
- JKKN College of Allied Health Sciences — https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in
- JKKN College of Education — https://edu.jkkn.ac.in
- JKKN Matriculation Higher Secondary School — https://school.jkkn.ac.in
- Nattraja Vidhyalaya CBSE School — https://nv.jkkn.ac.in

Note for B.Ed queries: teacher training is offered by **JKKN College of Education** at edu.jkkn.ac.in, not by this college.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Reference Answers)

**Q: Is JKKN College of Arts and Science autonomous?**
A: Yes. It holds UGC-granted autonomous status and is affiliated to Periyar University, Salem. Autonomy means the college sets its own curriculum and conducts its own examinations; the degree is awarded by Periyar University.

**Q: Which university awards the degrees?**
A: Periyar University, Salem.

**Q: When was JKKN College of Arts and Science established?**
A: 1974, as Alamelu Angappan College for Women. It became co-educational in 2008. It is part of JKKN Institutions, an educational group established in 1952 and governed by the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, registered in 1969.

**Q: How many programmes does the college offer?**
A: 34 — 19 undergraduate, 12 postgraduate and 3 Ph.D. Three further AI-oriented undergraduate programmes are proposed and awaiting university approval.

**Q: What is the difference between aided and self-finance programmes here?**
A: Aided programmes are government-aided with fees in the Rs 5,000 to Rs 12,000 per year range. Self-finance programmes are funded by the college, with fees from about Rs 15,000 to Rs 45,000 per year for UG.

**Q: Does the college offer B.Sc. Artificial Intelligence?**
A: Yes — B.Sc. Artificial Intelligence & Data Science is offered under self-finance. B.Com. (AI), B.Sc. Textile and Fashion Designing (AI) and B.Sc. Visual Communication (AI) are proposed and not yet approved.

**Q: What is the placement record?**
A: The placement cell publishes 92%+ placement across eligible learners for 2024-25, with 60+ recruiters including TCS, Infosys and Wipro, and a highest package of Rs 12 LPA.

**Q: How many students and faculty are there?**
A: 1,969+ students. The faculty includes 39 Ph.D. holders and 25 SET/NET qualified staff.

**Q: Is there a donation or capitation fee?**
A: No. The college states that it is donation-free and admits on merit.

**Q: Where is the college located?**
A: Natarajapuram, NH-544, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183, on a 15-acre campus. It is about 22 km from Erode, 20 km from Tiruchengode and 55 km from Salem.
